The '''Varrock Rooftop Course''' is a [[Rooftop Agility Course]] located in [[Varrock]] that is available to players with an [[Agility]] level of 30 or higher. It is preceded by the [[Al Kharid Rooftop Course]] and followed by the [[Canifis Rooftop Course]].

The Varrock Rooftop Agility course can be started by climbing the Rough Wall on the east side of the [[Varrock General Store|General Store]] and is finished by jumping off the house south of [[Lowe's Archery Emporium|Lowe's Archery shop]]. Players get 270 experience from completing the course, including 144 experience upon completion of the course. The course takes approximately 1 minute and 10 seconds. Using this course, one can reach approximately 14,000 experience per hour. Players will receive an average of 8–11.3 [[mark of grace|marks of grace]] per hour on this course.

It is possible to fail during Cross Clothes Line and Balance Wall and get inflicted with 3–8 and 2–5 damage respectively.

Completing a lap of the Varrock Rooftop agility course is a medium task for the [[Varrock Diary Medium|Varrock Achievement Diary]].
